title: Kissed Argentinian Dum Empanadas
description: A halal-friendly, citrusy, shattering take on the classic Argentinian empanada featuring lemon zest and dum.
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Add lard or shortening and, using a pastry blender or your fingers, work it into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add grated lemon zest and mix well.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring with a fork until the dough comes together in a ball.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch (3 mm).
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
Place 1 tablespoon of chopped onion in the center of each dough circle.
Place 1 piece of dum on top of the onion.
Brush the edges of the dough with beaten egg.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with a little bit of egg for a golden glaze.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
